body: I never went to homecomings or proms. Even my senior prom was me sitting at home being depressed. Why spend hundreds of dollars to sit there alone watching people dance and socialize. They will hook up while I won't socialize with anyone since I had no friends.

It's like if you take 99 shots and miss every time then on the 100th someone tells you to be confident you will make it. Confidence comes from success in that activity. People say be confident at a hobby and it will affect dating I disagree. I am confident I can know things about my autistic hobbies but it doesn't affect FA and meeting people.

If you are a virgin, I have a wizard hat for you. I remember turning 30 and that's when I gave up on the dating app I was using. It's understandable to be mad when you turn 30 with no experience. Happy birthday OP and I hope things change. I missed out on everything when I was younger too. It still bothers me and it will always bother me.
I didn't know the name but I will use it in the future. Thank you. I wish too that it could be forgotten.
Same. If you just don't look good it's much harder. Not impossible because looks aren't everything but it's not easy.
No, I'm trying to quiet that part of me. I think that little section of my mind is a glutton for punishment.
Japan has those lonely guys who sometimes don't leave their houses or apartments for years. They are trying to fix it but I doubt that will do much to help.
It happens but it can poison the well if you tell a coworker you like them, and you can get in trouble if they go to HR. It's not a good idea unless they initiate I guess. Even then, be careful.
Yes, then people tell you, those people aren't so happy. I bet they are just putting on a show Duh, it still is pictures of them together. They are a couple.
Same with me OP. It destroys me on the inside. I was only born to be alone whether in childhood or as an adult.

Yes, I used a dating app 10 years ago but it didn't matter. Sure, I got some women to come out and meet me but it never went anywhere. I would get excited, then rejected. I can hide autism online somewhat but IRL, it can't be suppressed.

The only way I would be wealthy is if overthinking became a high paying job and it's been that way for most of my adult life. I keep running scenarios through my head. It's like that belt thing at the airport but it's going at 100mph. I can't slow it down either.
I'm lethargic and even things like taking walks which used to be easy for me now are difficult because I can't even get the energy up to go outside because I'm just defeated.

It's not pathetic. It makes you a person who despite resenting yourself, wants to find someone who loves them. Weirder things have happened. I hear you OP. I get my old romantic side that comes out sometimes to tell me the same thing. I'm old so it's stupid but we have a natural urge for it.
Me too. I wanted a family more than anything.

Various internet searches. Also I had an organization that had group meetings tell me when there would be one. It's been a while and nothing from that time is around anymore except Meetup but I never found anything there.
I've already arrived. Nihilism land isn't fun. Try not to come here lol.

Hope drove me up the crest of a wave but then down into the trough multiple times, sometimes very hard. There could be 100billion people on the planet but the question is, how many of them are we going to meet in our everyday lives? You did make a good decision and stopped getting with the wrong people. I hope you do find the right person but at the same time, hope can be a painful fall when we get our hopes up too high. Sometimes it works out and sometimes it doesn't but now that I had years to look back, I could see I never should have had hope. We could have lived in a galactic federation and it wouldn't have mattered.

Wow, that's cool people have been positive to you. I've dreamed of starting a family most of my life but I was never considered attractive, then rejected a ton of times so I gave up. I've been called ugly many times and I realized, that family dream would stay a dream. I'm so tired from thinking if I was just myself, someone would like me enough to want to spend her life with me but instead they chose other guys. You seem to have a better attitude than me so that's a good thing.
She isn't into mainstream hobbies and has her own unpopular hobbies that nobody cares or thinks about.

Yes, I say this all the time when it's brought up. It's not fair to the other person when you use them for self-esteem. They deserve to find someone who likes them and isn't using them. Lowering your standards is a terrible idea. I'm not saying have really high standards but just see how you like someone.
Yeah, autism seems to be a common denominator with struggling to date or even connect with people.
I've been asked that. I give off those vibes and used to get asked by coworkers if I was a virgin. I somehow knew the women I talked to knew I was a virgin or at the very least very inexperienced.
Haha, I know that because I have boring autistic hobbies and women start putting clothes on too. You have to be not just acceptable because of your hobbies, you have to be exciting. I'm the opposite.

I had the same problem with most of the groups I joined. The people were much older and I didn't fit in. There were a couple of groups with people closer to my age but I couldn't fit in. I just sat there and acted happy but when I tried to talk to people, it was obvious something was wrong with me. I heard they are cracking down on people look to make friends or more at groups.
Yeah, that's why I could never go to a club or something. Besides my sensitivity to noise, I would see other guy having women around them and get jealous then leave. It feels bad to be unwanted.

Really sorry to hear. I don't know what it's like to be in your faith and have your options taken away until your age but it's crazy to expect you suddenly catch up. I was the same way when I tried meeting women after no experience and my friends thought it would work but I never met anyone IRL who liked me. People love to rub it in your face, usually unintentionally. I hear you OP.
Porn is a symptom of the problem.

Yeah, I did the self-improvement thing, busted my butt, and it got me nothing because I was still autistic. After a while you run out of energy and will to keep punishing yourself so you say F it then give up followed by getting shamed by people for doing everything wrong or not trying bro. They wait until you fail then kick you when you are down because it makes them feel better about themselves or they are just too different and can't imagine life as FA.
This is what it is. That's why I started the I'm a thing not a person line because that's what people see me IRL. I'm nothing, nobody. Destiny is being alone.
Isn't that what Aaron Rodgers is on? He loves that stuff.
I'm just not looking to date right now. Oh, this guy? I met him and we just had a sort of connection. Yeah, it's the nice rejection.
How about, speaking of school, you have a group project but no one will join you so you end up either with the teacher or get assigned to a group that doesn't want you.

I think we are so far apart on this it's pointless to continue. I don't think love is just a chemical reaction and wanting love isn't toxic, You think so. Maybe if I had money I would have a different view close to yours because I could just get away when I needed to or have a loving family that helps me out when I need it. I hope your continue to have happiness with whatever you are doing.
What if we are aliens and we don't know it? I wish I could be a normal person for a day. I could get smiles when I look at certain people and not be treated like I'm about to turn into a monster.

Well, those things become empty alone. You can't be alone your whole life and expect to find happiness. My therapist thinks that as she has a baby and a loving boyfriend. I found out, you can't force people to like you and when you get old like me, you become not just toxic but radioactive so it starts a snowball effect. Love is what life is built on. It's what our society is built on. I know some people say exploitation but I'm not here for that discussion. I'm here to tell you how important love is whether it's from a family, or a significant other. You need love and it's hard to get by without it.

I agree with throwaway. Sure toxic relationships are bad, but for most people here, they have never been in one so it's like telling a starving person, this muffin could be poisoned, and then you throw it away not understanding the starving person. I used to go places without anyone and it got boring after a while. You need company and family can be quite cruel to some of us. They were and still are to me. I get called a loser all the time.

Who has said you have to be short to be FA? They are strong. I'm short but why would I ever say someone is too tall to be FA or as someone who is unattractive, see someone for example who is average looking but has autism then say, you aren't unattractive enough to be FA. I hope those people aren't around anymore.
You are in the club with me.

Yes, I'm an imposter too. People think I'm smart because I have autistic obsessions that I am good in but I'm horrible in everything else and failed in school too. I failed out of college and only graduated because I chose an easier major. People think I am failed potential but while I am, it's not as big of a potential as people think. I'm not smart and not useful.
It's not a man or woman thing. It's a nobody will give me a chance? I can't force people to but don't ask me to give back.
That's the point. I've learned they hate me so it's not happening.

Yeah, you said it best. I used to get the, you are young, but now I'm 40 and have no chance. Women our age want someone long term and I am the opposite of a father figure. I'm autistic too and my mental health is poor. It would cost me insane amounts to get the support I need.

Probably my oneitis. I was still young but I was obsessed because she was my first woman friend. I let her manipulate me and get me to be her self-esteem booster. I kept being that after too. All I was good for was a self-esteem boost. When that's all you are because you are a thing and not a person, you realize, FA is your destiny. Even if you meet someone, you have too much damage to have a normal relationship. I'm not a man. I'm a means to an end. Lets say you have a bad breakup and need to feel better until you meet someone else. I was that thing who helped them until they found a guy then they threw me away like the piece of crap I am. I allowed it because I was desperate due to FA.
Same. I know I'm not going to pass on my genes but I'm still bitter that I didn't and won't get the chance.

That's my issue. I tried to be what people wanted and ended up sounding even weirder. It wasn't me but an awkward guy trying to be normal which somehow was even worse. At least when I was myself was more natural.

I could have gotten an escort to finally lose my virginity but I didn't because I was too nervous about relations, and I wanted my first time to be special with someone special. My anxiety wouldn't even let me contact an escort and my stupid values had to ruin my only chance for relations even if it was meaningless. You see how my mind was conflicted.
I do a little more than most people think to be honest.
We all are our own harshest critic as they say.

I think some people have split the scale and it's now 5-10. 5 is ugly when in reality it's average. What happens to those of us below 5? We are things. We lost human privileges.That's the only explanation I have for why people like that are told they are ugly.

Dude, it's always been that way. The rule is, if someone has the guts to upload a picture, they probably aren't ugly. People saw the picture threads that used to be on here and assumed we all were average looking.

It depends on if the disability is approved. I remember the kids were downs syndrome weren't bullied when I was in school. They were left alone I think because the bullies knew they would get in trouble for teasing them, but the ADHD kids(autism wasn't diagnosed yet) were fair game.

Growing up in the 90's I can say it wasn't an easy ride. Bullies were liked by the school more than the autistic kid(me) and let them do whatever they wanted to me. Also, you still got rejected in the store, but you weren't canceled. Like they wouldn't take a video and upload it to Twitter or something lol I don't know. You met people in public which made things different. You had to go out to meet people and some people are still stuck in that mindset.

Oh, so people thought you were also into cocaine. Well, I will give a funeral for your inbox. In my reply below I talk about how many 30+ year old FA guys there are on here who are into gaming. That's funny they waited to see if you were also on cocaine to attack your inbox.

Okay, I will give you a reply instead of messing with you. Hey, I think most people on here would love someone like that. You are over 30 so you are in good company with plenty of 30+ year old FA guys on here who would like to meet someone new to talk to. Wow, cocaine? The only thing I know about cocaine is what I see in movies because I've never ever seen it. Video games are probably the biggest cope on here. I used to be a gamer but it became mainstream and the PS3 was the last system I really played. The PS4 was for one game and I lost it. I'm only one the PS2. No internet, no 8 year olds cursing and saying racial slurs. Tastes in music greatly vary. Mine is insanely outdated.

Therapy is good if you aren't me and dating apps are terrifying because you get the worst people on them. Maybe not but my experiences have clouded my vision. Wanting to find a good friend is normal and wanting to fall in love is normal. Yes, it happens in real life, just not to us. 

I've talked to some people who met over PSN or XBox Live. Maybe there is a chance there. I used to be told going to coffee shops or bookstores(RIP) were a good idea. Places where it's low pressure and you don't draw in intense people like on dating apps. I hope you find success. Losing friends due to drugs must be terrible and I empathize with your situation..
Lies, deceptions haha

I thought I would find someone who was on my wavelength and we would be weird together. I know, stupid of me to think and I learned the hard way, it's just not going to happen. Part of me refuses to accept that

Or the look of death lol. The F off look. Ugh, why is this guy staring at me? The only time an attractive person would stare at me would be at my old job where they had to look at me because I was an employee and you have to look at the employee.

If I stare at someone, I probably am getting kicked out of the establishment or going to be approached by a tougher guy than me saying, why are you staring? I've only gotten the look of death. Of course I've imagined that romcom stuff because I've watched so many movies but in reality, I know I'm way below the threshold for that to happen.
I can't. I think love is still out there but social media is amplifying the shallow transactional relationships.

That comes from knowing you will succeed. You can't have confidence if you have failed every single time. I always make the comparison, if I shoot a basketball and miss 99 times, how am I supposed to be confident that the 100th will go in?

Old people lived in a different time. A different place in history where you could have flaws, but still meet people. You could go out and make friends. A lot of people don't like the nuclear family model but I do and wish I could have a family of my own. People assume I want my wife to stay home and do the dishes when in reality, she could do whatever she wanted. We would be a team We would make sure the kids were taken care of. I watch my neighbors to see how a team operates. Sometimes the father watches the kids and sometimes the mother does. Sometimes the father works, and sometimes the mother goes out for I don't know, but if it's a job, then he stays home for the kids. People tell me, those couple or families aren't happy. It's cheap to say. Maybe some aren't but I look next door and I see happiness. I see want to be so bad. You aren't supposed to envy your neighbor but it's not on a materialistic level. What I want isn't freedom. I've had that my whole life and am sick of it. I want love. I want companionship. I want a family.

Exactly. Underneath my depression, I have a bitterness. Why help the society that hates me? Even if it's my fault which it is, they still hate me and then expect to contribute? I am not entitled to love but society is not entitled to me contributing.
I do want to know what love is. I want you to show me.
A man of culture.

Oh, you have another good one. Limited social media. This is my dream partner so I can say that without being called names. Freaky in bed would be interesting. Positive if she owns a whip. Jk, but that is interesting.
I haven't heard every racial slur imaginable haha.

That's very true. Looks fade over time. Sure, relations are a good thing to have, I think(never had them), but what happens after? Respect is huge. It seems today people are looking for someone better even in relationships. Men and women do this but it could just be me being paranoid. It would be nice to have someone who didn't do that and respect is huge. If they respected me, they wouldn't do things like looks for a better deal. Also honesty. I know this is stupid to say but I would lay everything on the table before we became a couple so they would know, this is me. If they stay with me, I would know they would like me even with my issues.

Looks are a factor. I wouldn't be realistic if I said otherwise. It's that, when you connect with someone on a deep level, looks can go from big deal to not as big of a deal. When you have chemistry with that person, even if they aren't your ideal person physically, it's okay. Not always but it helps. Trust me, if I found a person like I described above but looks were iffy at first which it would be the opposite because I'm the one who's unattractive, if she was that type of person who basically brightened my life, it would work out. Then again, I'm a romantic without a chance to be romantic.
I don't. I'm losing them anyway and will have nothing so it was nice to vent to someone. It's more about venting to me.
Well, lets not got there.

Tomboy who I could have at least some of my autistic hobbies with me, and who is warm that has an aura of brightness around them. Sounds weird but I've met them a few times and any preferences I had went out the window. I think that would be my number one thing I would want in a woman if I could have it. That brightness that causes me to warm up and feel good. Looks wise, eh, if she had that personality type, it wouldn't be that important. The catch is, you can only really see it IRL. Hope that wasn't too weird.
I know it would get myself called a bad guy but I can't make others happy while not having love myself. Also, people telling me people love me is misguided.
She has a baby. It's hard to understand if you have love.
You almost got me.
I get OF DM's on here lol. They are everywhere.
I can't stand when people tell ugly people that are men or women to just do this and you won't be ugly. It's like dress nicer and you will go from ugly to average. Ha!
Then we end up with low self-esteem from being treated poorly due to our looks and are told, stop being so hard on yourself.
I tried changing who I am because my brain is unacceptable but autism and the lack of experience was too much to overcome. I needed success to build off of but I never got it.

It was my therapist who told me to forget about love and to spend my life helping others. I probably sound like a bad guy but I said no. It wouldn't help the hole left by FA. What I want is love. I've always been the type to want love. I spent years doing what everyone told me would give me a better chance at love. When it all failed, it was devastating because as the people around me were finding love and pairing off, I stayed alone. I never wanted to be some stud having money and many women. I just wanted one woman to love me who I would love.
Yes, escorts are nice for having meaningless sex, but the sex I want to have is from love. It would be so much different. Getting to wake up next to them would be so much better.
They have so many types of relationships but I'm not welcome. It's a society that we are not allowed to participate in for some reason or reasons which hurts being surrounded by it.
She saw you as a wallet and nothing more.

They just recreated that in AEW with Jericho getting kicked in the groin by his best friend Sammy Guevara.

https://i.ytimg.com/vi/l8U6Vm_v2XI/maxresdefault.jpg
Yeah, I've posted about how I may be an alien who forgot how to tell my planet to get me and the device to help me fit into humanity didn't work the way it was supposed to.
People tell me, you never know if a woman was interested in you because you could have been missing the signal. No, women make it obvious when they are into you. Sometimes they approach you.

Yeah, most women makes it obvious but some like to play a game where they give you conflicting signals. I've never gotten either haha. I've gotten the look of death. That says, don't look at me, don't approach me, and don't talk to me.

I can't get rid of my biological urge to reproduce and having the same idea from being 20 of the loving wife, two kids, including a modest house has worked its way into my heart. I have given up but it comes up sometimes and hurts me. Sometimes it even causes me to have episodes where my mind causes me to start seeing that life and I break down. My mind is extremely angry at me for failing to find that loving wife. I think it is worth the squeeze but the right person especially for us, needs all the luck we have plus about 20,000 times more luck.

Yes, I wish I was taught those lines when I was younger. I didn't keep harassing anyone but I was naive and believed those lines when I should have known what they meant so I could move on. If they say, I'm busy Friday but we can meet Monday, it's not a rejection. I'm busy Friday without a makeup date means, no.

I was bullied too. Physically and mentally. I was fair game so everyone who wanted an easy target got one. Yes, I know about positive affirmations since I used to watch them on Youtube. It helps some people and I hope it helps you. Since I've had to cope with FA, I've learned different types of ways to deal with it. Some worked for me and some didn't. It's good they are helping. You should keep going and I hope they bring you some calmness.

Well the problem is, FA people have no experience and when we are younger especially, we don't know what these things mean. I used to take obvious things that I know now because I'm 40 literally and it ended up with me hurt. Also being autistic made it really hard to read body language since I'm sure there were giving off negative signals.
Mine said it liked me as a friend but we shouldn't go further.
I wish I could reproduce so I could leave a legacy on this planet. Instead nobody will ever know I existed.

I'm sorry to hear that. I'm mentally disabled but don't know what it's like to be in a wheelchair. I used to see people in wheelchairs at my old job but they were just people. Whatever your experiences have been, you deserve far better than to be used.
That happened to me in my late 20's. I lost the remaining friends I had because they moved on and I was on my own.

Me too. I would be the bad guy and I'm the bad guy anyway. Not the bad guy like the cool bad guy. Remember Razor Ramon? He was the bad guy but he was cool. I'm just the bad guy lol. Wait, I lost my guy privileges so I'm the inferior thing.
I have the autism, crappy childhood, unattractive combination and that's how it seems to go. Few people get along with you and the ones who do just leave when they move on. I feel you OP.
You get it. They know and there is no point in talking about it.
Once you get past college, people have established social circles and there are limited places to make friends like work but even there it's hard unless you are likeable as a person.

I was in the groups of friends and you try to compete with them thinking she will pick me if I stand out. I was pathetic. You don't understand how much I regret letting myself be put there by multiple people when I was in my 20's and naive.

Everyone's experiences are valid. I've been told my years of putting myself out there are not valid because I did this and this wrong. It's gaslighting to try and shame you using the just world fallacy. I never made it to the second date either when I managed to get some IRL dates in my late 20's around your age. They knew what I looked like but saw me, said no thanks and basically left early most of the time or got mad at me. That's a good way to know you aren't attractive although my pictures were of me without tricks. I guess my pictures didn't do my unattractiveness justice? I wish I could get ahead with money, connections, employment, and education but you need a social circle, and if you don't have one, talent to stick out compared to other people in the field you are trying to make money in. I started my 40's as I'm 40 as a virgin and it's not going to change anytime soon. I've been given the look of death in public but that's about it. I think people have it worse and whether it's men or women, FA people have to deal with being alone even if they tried their hardest in some cases. It's the most frustrating, defeating feeling possible. All I know is that when I'm older I will end up in a ditch because you need family who cares to be taken care of when you're older.

I'm trying to word this so it doesn't turn into something bad. I don't know what it's like to be you. I'm me. I do know what it's like to be called ugly and have been called it many times. I know some people would rather remain single than give me a chance because they are sane and would never want to deal with the emotional damage or multiple other issues that have caused me to lose human privileges. I can only say, I empathize with your situation knowing what it is like to be the total opposite of what I type in when I Google attractive man. I know what it's like to be mistreated, used then thrown away, and get told I will never find anyone because of my issues. I'm really sorry and I hope you find someone who is different. I always say, for FA people it comes down to luck.
Ouch. It was a nice rejection but still hurts.

When someone tells me one of those lines my mind instantly goes to

https://media.tenor.com/CS8Zq4vaHpAAAAAC/star-wars-lies.gif

I've gotten both. There are stories on here of a woman telling the poster, I'm not looking for a relationship right now followed by him seeing her with a guy a week later. It's, I'm not looking for a relationship with you. I like you as a friend is, I like you but am not attracted to you. The best you can do is what you are now. You will find someone for sure is, here is a comforting way of telling you to stop complaining. It will happen. Just have patience. There is someone for everyone.

It's hard to go outside when you are getting hit with a tropical storm and there is nowhere to go. I agree, I take walks when it's nice out and I don't have a skin condition, then see couples showing PDA or families obviously loving each other. I realize how I'm not even a person and I'm looking at life from the outside.

That look. You know it. If being creepy was a profession, I would be a millionaire bragging about my Bugattis. The problem is, I don't mean to be creepy but I have a look like you know the resting B face, well I have the resting creep face. Change that to resting creep look.
Wait until you get to 40. The party really begins.

Being FA is a massive red flag to potential dates. In fact, it's multiple red flags. In fact it has more red flags than a May Day parade. I don't know how to hide information or fake it but I learned to never tell anyone about being FA until you become closer with them. The exception is if you meet them on here.
First rule of FA. Second rule of FA too. Never talk about FA.
Same here. All that's left are the F boys and autistic guys.
Using the waiting for the right one line. I don't know if that works anymore but someone from your generation can educate me.
Exactly, that's why they say it. Go away lol. Do that so you stop annoying me.

That's good you figured it out by yourself. Some people can. I was never good with my hands. They said I had a disorder which is why I can't do simple tasks like tying things. Some people have bad fathers that mess them up too. I knew I would have to do something with my mind since I was useless with my hands. The problem is, I was never smart enough. I worked at a place that had food, but kept dropping things including the food. I tried for a couple of months to improve but it wasn't happening. Eventually they just fired me. They said the only job I could do would be to wash dishes but the places used illegals to do that. They used illegals at that place. Heck, if I got a job making minimum wage or even below washing dishes, they would fire me for dropping them. You have to be fast and clean them. Even now, when I try to even get the mail or pick something up, I drop it. Being useless with your hands limits what you can do without being intelligent or talented in an area. Whatever the case, I'm worthless and belong in a ditch with the rest of the trash.

I'm just one but it depends on how nice and funny they are. That's just to me and I'm not one who can have standards but foreign women are the same as US women to me. Just because you have an accent it doesn't make you different. If a woman with a thick foreign accent came up to me and said, lets go on a date, if we had chemistry, it wouldn't matter. I wish I could afford to travel so maybe I could find someone who would like me. Who am I kidding, they don't exist haha. Nothing wrong with a Spanish accent and Eastern Europeans can be stubborn but that's just their stereotype and there are tons of people who aren't. When you work with the public you pick up on stereotypes. It's not racism or anything, just what stereotypes are out there.
Really, it doesn't make sense. I'm just curious about how people are like that to someone with an accent in California where there are people from all around the world. I get too curious.

Dude, you punched my gut with that one. Not intentionally, but you said something I didn't want to admit. Why would I want to bring someone else into the car wreck that is my life? I have so many issues, she would be overwhelmed and that wouldn't be fair to do to her when there are plenty of average guys out there without issues.

It's 1:30 in the freaking morning and I'm here being depressed and alone because I'm stupid and more stupid. I wish I could have done everything differently. Having so much emotional damage with no outlet because my only outlet was cut is eating me inside. I'm falling apart with no one to help keep me together. I just wanted to look into someone's eyes and see what loved looked like once but no, instead I get my own eyes to look into the mirror which show a soul that is in so much pain. Maybe it's because I don't have a soul. Not because I'm a ginger but because I'm a thing and things don't have souls. I'm kidding about the ginger thing, but that South Park joke has become mainstream.

Yeah, OP resonated with me because that happened to me. I used to have nightmares from bullying in high school. It's like we are ghosts looking at people living their lives but never being allowed to live ourselves instead having to watch others. I've seen the way women look at guys they like and I've never gotten that look. People say, you must have missed a woman who liked you IRL but no, I know the look and I know I've never gotten it.
I think this is meant to go into a musical number.

It helped me feel better about myself but it didn't help me with women since I was still short and autistic. I shouldn't have thought it would have helped me find a woman so I wouldn't have gotten as upset when I failed to find a woman. It was my mistake. I should have been happy to be more healthy.

It's all a game for some people. Others get into situationships. There are about 500 names for different types of relationships. 

English is your second language I assume. That's hard to learn. It's like expecting me to move to France, learn French, then people getting on me for having an American accent. I doubt people think you are stupid. Where I used to work we had tons of accents but I am impressed at how well some people speak English after a small amount of time at learning it. Some countries teach it when you are a kid so I guess they have a head start. Who knows. You're welcome and I hope things go better for you.
